facts.fact: The World Bank concept-stage PID for Digital Eswatini says back-end interoperability frameworks are currently underdeveloped and that a robust whole-of-government interoperability framework led by the Ministry of Information, Communication and Technology is needed, with no framework stated as drafted; dated by the document's own preparation date, 28 June 2025.

note: Fact records stated absence of a framework; the Digital Eswatini project itself is not a framework.
